pre_capture_js: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('[data-capture-anchor="p20-image4-target"]').forEach(el => el.removeAttribute('data-capture-anchor')); const modalInner = document.querySelector('gs-modal otto-web-upload-drivers-modal'); const modal = modalInner ? modalInner.closest('gs-modal') : null; const profilePage = document.querySelector('otto-web-driver-profile-page'); const target = modal || profilePage; if (target) { target.setAttribute('data-capture-anchor', 'p20-image4-target'); } const fileDrop = document.querySelector('.file_drop[data-content], [data-qa-id="file_drop"][data-content], [gsqaid="file_drop"][data-content]'); if (fileDrop) { const localized = 'Trascina e rilascia il tuo file qui o sfoglia'; fileDrop.setAttribute('data-content', localized); const currentText = (fileDrop.textContent || '').trim(); if (currentText && /arrastre y suelte su archivo/i.test(currentText)) { fileDrop.textContent = localized; } } })();
